title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. What is the minimum head count for Jumuah prayer to be valid in Hanafi & Shafi' Fiqh? 10646 views Q. In our Masjid we have 2 Jumu'ah Salaat due to lack of space. The time is very limited so by the time the 2nd Jumu'ah Salaat ends, within 10 minutes Asr time starts. As such most of the musallees who come for 2nd Jumu'ah also want to perform Asr. But the official Asr Jama'at conducted by the main Imam takes place 1 hour after. The other Imam who leads the second Jumu'ah is insisted upon to lead this unofficial Asr Jama'at. Let me tell you a little bit about the Masjid: -We have an appointed Imam -We do not have an appointed Mu'azzin -We have a group of local people who come for every Salaat What procedure should be taken to conduct this unofficial Asr Jama'at without making it Makrooh Tahrimi or Makrooh Tanzihi in Hanafi Mathab? 3268 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 36921 Country: INDIA Title: Please tell me if Jumuah salah is fardh or wajib? Please provide detail about Jumuah salah Question: Please tell me if Jumuah salah is fardh or wajib? Please provide detail about Jumuah salah? Answer ID: 36921 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 442/352/D=1433) It is fardh provided the conditions of Jumuah are met. Sometime the word of wujub is spoken and written in the context of fardh as there is no difference between them as per practice. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
